record.field: Read all BoMs. Create new BoMs freely (manual or Excel import). Modify or delete existing BoMs only while they are not used in any Manufacturing Order or while a related ECO is open. Apply ECOs they validated.

Bypass PLM lock restrictions on Bills of Materials. Intended for users who run maintenance or system-level server actions (e.g. route synchronisation, dependency setup) on production BoMs without creating an ECO. WARNING: members can also edit locked BoMs directly from the form view; assign with care.
